package.description: Package folder the plugin infers, passed as --package-path

product.description: Executable product the plugin infers from swift package describe

entitlements.description: Entitlements file <module>.entitlements among the sources of the module the product builds, signed into the product where present

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Install
description: Builds a SwiftPM executable product in release, signs a copy staged beside ~/.local/bin/<product>, the per-user folder launchd's PATH holds, under the Apple Development identity with the hardened runtime, and puts it there by one renamex_np, RENAME_SWAP exchanging it with the executable installed there, or where the volume refuses that rename with ENOTSUP, EINVAL, or EXDEV by two renames moving the installed executable aside first, leaving the path empty between them
